caveats: Single-user screens, not full model routing traces or sustained thermal tests.
O_DIRECT bypasses OS page cache, not drive/controller caches.

5.scope: Optimistic throughput bounds, not model generation measurements or quality qualification.
limitations: Storage rate and IOPS are independently measured; their resources are shared, not additive.
Layer routing dependencies and per-miss tail latency reduce actual overlap.
Engram page coalescing, caching and alignment are workload-dependent.
No cache hit rate, compute time or prefetch precision is inferred from model parameter count.
Wrong predictions fetch extra bytes but must never replace actual router-selected experts.
